summary: Rockingham County, Virginia, tower site that the Forest Fire Lookout Association lists as gone, with the type marked uncertain. No source found describes its history or the site today.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no current source describes the site.

evidence.supports: West Mountain in Rockingham County at 38.79652, -78.9297; listed as a tower and gone
County list gives the type as a tower with a question mark; status gone
State forestry office began putting up steel lookout towers in 1928
evidence.quote: In 1928 the Office of the State Forester embarked on a program of constructing steel lookout towers throughout Virginia

evidence.supports: 1991 survey: the department owned fire towers in every county
evidence.quote: The Department of Forestry owns fire towers in every county in the commonwealth.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only sources are two Forest Fire Lookout Association Virginia lists, which give name, county, coordinates, a hedged 'Tower?' type and status gone. No NHLR or FFLOS entry, no build or staffing date, no access note and no photo were found. Two searches returned only topographic map pages and a West Mountain in New York. The Forest Lookouts page titled West Mountain is the New York tower (Hamilton County), not this one. The record's kind 'tower' is firmer than the source's 'Tower?'; an editor may want to mark it uncertain. The two FFLA lists differ only by 0.00001 degree of longitude. The 1928 and 1991 sentences describe the statewide program; no source ties West Mountain to it.
